findings.statement: CA9 is up in tumour at RNA (log2FC 6.312, padj 1.72e-49) and protein (log2FC 2.269, padj 9.9e-43), with RNA-protein Spearman rho 0.797; TCGA-KIRC replicates (log2FC 9.712) and the purity-extrapolated RNA log2FC is 7.787, so the signal is tumour-intrinsic.

NNMT is strongly up at RNA (log2FC 4.67, padj 2.04e-40) and protein (log2FC 2.709, padj 1.23e-43); it replicates in TCGA (log2FC 4.685) and higher expression is prognostic for worse survival (log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479).

CD70 is up at RNA (log2FC 4.464) and protein (log2FC 2.421); TCGA replicates (log2FC 7.09), purity-extrapolated RNA log2FC is 4.278, and it is a membrane target with clinical-stage anti-CD70 agents (cusatuzumab Phase 2).
ENPP3 is up at RNA (log2FC 3.895) and protein (log2FC 1.544), replicates in TCGA (log2FC 5.557), and has 0.182 frequency of copy loss; the ADC AGS-16C3F reached Phase 2.
SCARB1 ranks first in the target profile: RNA log2FC 2.974 and protein log2FC 1.837, TCGA log2FC 3.989; the purity-extrapolated RNA log2FC is 3.762, indicating tumour-cell expression.
SLC16A3 (MCT4, a membrane lactate transporter) is up at RNA (log2FC 3.435) and protein (log2FC 2.279) and replicates in TCGA (log2FC 3.291).

PSAT1 is down in tumour at RNA (log2FC -3.867) and protein (log2FC -1.963) and tops the biomarker profile; TCGA Cox log HR 0.43 (padj 5.66e-7). The direction reflects loss of tubule identity rather than a target.
PCK1 is down in tumour at RNA (log2FC -4.424) and protein (log2FC -1.859), replicates in TCGA (log2FC -3.079), and low expression predicts worse survival (log HR -0.415, padj 1.91e-7).

ALDH6A1 is down (RNA log2FC -3.399, protein log2FC -1.925) with 0.355 copy-loss frequency and positive cis effect (rho 0.525); low expression is prognostic (log HR -0.554), a 3p-linked loss of tubule metabolism.
PPP1R1A is down at RNA (log2FC -2.974) and protein (log2FC -1.139), TCGA log2FC -5.179, and higher expression is worse in Cox terms (log HR 0.403, padj 0.00000155).
VHL on 3p shows copy loss in 0.791 of CPTAC tumours and is mutated in 247 of 511 patients (freq 0.483), consistent with the disease driver behind HIF targets such as CA9.
PBRM1 has 3p copy loss in 0.8 of tumours and recurrent mutation in 185 of 511 patients (freq 0.362, padj 4.59e-239).

caveats: Purity extrapolation and TCGA replication are RNA-based; protein only in CPTAC.
DepMap ccRCC dependency is near zero for most top targets, so up-regulation does not imply essentiality.
Down-regulated genes mainly reflect lost tubule identity; they are biomarkers, not targets.
Cohort is small (110 tumours; 75-84 matched normals).
